BarChart3 -> SemanticIcon 'analytics' color note: the web title icon is `BarChart3 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-neon-green"` (L74) and the empty-state icon `BarChart3 className="h-5 w-5"` (L63, L85). lucide has no native renderer; SemanticIcon tone is fixed per name, so the text-neon-green tint collapses to the analytics icon's intrinsic tone — the same color-tint -> semantic-icon collapse precedent set by BackupMonitor (emerald->hardDrive) and AlertFeed (neon-cyan->notifications). Title icon -> size='sm' (web h-3.5≈sm); empty icon -> size='md' (web h-5 w-5≈md). The chart/charge-history semantic intent is preserved.

convertEnergyFromSI L12/L30 ported inline as wh -> kWh (wh/1000) with the EnergyUnit 'Wh'|'kWh' union, matching the RecentActivity native port. SI total_energy_added_wh stays on the wire; conversion happens only at the React render boundary (per the SI-cutover contract). The ChargingSession interface is ported verbatim for type fidelity; the widget consumes only the SI total_energy_added_wh field.

Component signature L14 export default function ChargeHistoryWidget({ vehicleId, size }: WidgetProps) preserved one-for-one (default export, destructured vehicleId+size). chartData useMemo L25-34 ported verbatim: (charges ?? []).map((s, i) => ({ i: String(i), energy: convertEnergyFromSI(s.total_energy_added_wh ?? 0, 'kWh') })).reverse(), dep [charges]. hasData L36 = chartData.length > 1 preserved. isCompact L37 = size.cols <= 1 preserved.

Standard branch L71-98: WidgetShell title=t('widget.chargeHistory.title','Charge History'), icon=<SemanticIcon name='analytics' size='sm'/> (web BarChart3 h-3.5 text-neon-green), same loading/updatedAt/isFetching/isStale/isError/onRefresh props; child WidgetChartSummary isEmpty={!hasData}, emptyMessage/emptyIcon as above, stats, and chart=<AreaChartWrapper data={chartData} xKey="i" series={[{key:'energy',label:'kWh',color:'#10b981'}]} height={200} yFormatter={(v)=>`${v} kWh`} /> — all chart props (xKey, series key/label/color, height 200, yFormatter) preserved verbatim against the ported native AreaChartWrapper. Inlined native WidgetChartSummary reproduces the web ./shared contract: isEmpty -> a centred icon+muted-caption empty view (web EmptyState icon+message, no title; the shared native EmptyState requires a title and takes no icon, so inlined like BackupMonitor's empty); else a flex-col with a stat row (web grid-cols-2 gap-2, @sm flex relaxation collapses to a single 2-col flex row — RN has no container queries) of min-w-0 cells rendering label (text-[10px] muted) over value (text-sm semibold primary) + optional inline unit (text-[10px] normal muted, leading space ≈ ml-0.5); the chart (web mt-2 min-h-0 flex-1) renders only when !compact. Inlined native WidgetShell reproduces the web shell subset this widget exercises (loading -> Skeleton placeholder View accessibilityRole progressbar; error -> ported QueryError in a centred padded View; titled header icon+uppercase 11px muted title+DataFreshness; title-less overlay DataFreshness; web L59-80 pulse-on-change effect ported verbatim with a green glow shadow). Unused query/help/widgetId/dashboardId/actions/noPadding props omitted; this widget never passes error so the error branch is structurally dead.

State/prop names (vehicleId, size, vehicles, id, charges/isLoading/isFetching/isStale/isError/dataUpdatedAt/refetch, chartData, hasData, isCompact, stats), API path ('/charging?vehicle_id=<id>&limit=10' + '/vehicles'), query key ['charging', id, 'recent-10'], snake_case query params, i18n keys (widget.chargeHistory.title/total/avg, widget.noChargeHistory), the size.cols<=1 compact breakpoint, the energy SI->kWh conversion, fmt 1-decimal formatting, and the chart series/height/yFormatter are all preserved. No SI unit-suffixed field is added — total_energy_added_wh is read as SI and converted only at display; the ChargingSession interface is ported verbatim from the existing web type. No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or web @/ UI imports remain — only react, react-native primitives (StyleSheet/View), @tanstack/react-query, the shared native SemanticIcon/AppText + theme tokens, and the ported parity AreaChartWrapper/fmt/useVehicles/request/DataFreshness/QueryError.
